summary: A split button (Publish plus a chevron DropdownMenu trigger) and a vertical ButtonGroup of two icon buttons.
use: A primary action with its alternatives behind a menu, or a stacked pair of icon controls.
spec: `<ButtonGroup aria-label="Publish">` with a `filled` Publish Button followed by a `DropdownMenu` whose `triggerChild` is a filled `IconButton` named "More publish options"
The menu has Schedule and Save as draft, aligned to the end
`<ButtonGroup aria-label="Pages" orientation="vertical">` with two outlined neutral IconButtons (Previous page, Next page)
Both groups sit in a wrapping row with `gap: var(--ca-space-6)`
